$description: Semantic tier: roles, as aliases only, with Forest values. semantic.paper.json overrides them for Paper. Names describe purpose and never mention a hue or theme.

subtle.$description: Quieter areas within a page. Only differs from the default in Paper.

default.$description: Body and heading text. 4.5:1 or more on every surface.

muted.$description: Labels and secondary text. 4.5:1 or more on every surface.

accent.$description: Emphasised text. 4.5:1 or more on every surface.

default.$description: Decorative rules and grid lines. Exempt from contrast minimums, so never a control's only boundary.

strong.$description: Control boundaries. 3:1 or more on every surface.

focus.$description: Focus indicator. 3:1 or more on every surface.

default.$description: Label on every primary action fill. 4.5:1 or more.
